question: The sides of a rectangle are in the ratio 5: 3 and its perimeter is 112 cm. The area of this rectangle is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Length** and **Breadth** = 5 : 3

Sum of ratio parts = 5 + 3 = 8 units

Semi-perimeter (L + B) = 112 ÷ 2 = 56 cm

1 unit = 56 ÷ 8 = 7 cm

Length = 5 × 7 = 35 cm, Breadth = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

Area = 35 × 21 = 735 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 735 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of sides = 5 : 3, Perimeter = 112 cm

**Formula Used:** Perimeter = 2(Length + Breadth); Area = Length × Breadth

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9167211b4d785533efdbda2e3c0b1ef33becf624452f969ad23581c2e2188ae1.png] 

⇒ Let Length (L) = 5x and Breadth (B) = 3x

⇒ Perimeter = 2(5x + 3x) = 112

⇒ 2(8x) = 112

⇒ 16x = 112

⇒ x = 112 ÷ 16 = 7

⇒ Length = 5 × 7 = 35 cm

⇒ Breadth = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

⇒ Area = 35 × 21 = 735 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 735 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral where opposite sides are equal and all angles are 90°. Diagonal d = √(L² + B²).

Perimeter and Area Relationship

For a given perimeter, the area of a rectangle is maximum when it is a square (L = B).

Diagonal of Rectangle

The diagonals of a rectangle are equal in length and bisect each other.</p
